pages.text: $(thing)Apotheosis$(/thing) gems slot into socketed equipment to provide permanent stat bonuses. Socket count is determined by the affix tier of the item — Common items have 0 sockets, Legendary items can have up to 4.$(br2)Gems come in 5 quality tiers: $(bold)Flawed → Chipped → Normal → Flawless → Perfect.$(/bold) Higher quality means stronger bonuses.

$(bold)Where Gems Come From$(/bold)$(br2)Gem quality scales with boss tier:$(br2)$(li)$(t1)T1$(end) bosses + Overworld chests → Flawed, Chipped$(li)$(t2)T2$(end) bosses + Dimensional chests → Normal, Flawless$(li)$(t3)T3$(end) bosses + Nether/Abyss chests → Flawless, Perfect$(li)$(t4)T4$(end) bosses + End chests → Perfect$(br2)Gems can also drop from loot boxes at the appropriate tier.

$(bold)Gem Cutting Table$(/bold)$(br2)The Gem Cutting Table ($(thing)Apotheosis$(/thing)) allows upgrading gems by combining multiples:$(br2)$(li)3 Flawed → 1 Chipped$(li)3 Chipped → 1 Normal$(li)3 Normal → 1 Flawless$(li)3 Flawless → 1 Perfect$(br2)The table itself is $(t2)Tier 2$(end) gated (requires a $(t2)T2$(end) token to craft). Gem cutting is mid-game-accessible.
